pages.text: Create is the primary Tier 1 tech mod. Mechanical power, automated crafting, and item transport.

$(bold)Role in the pack:$() Your first automation engine, and the heart of the Tier 1 $(bold)Engineering$() lane. Brass is the T1 ceiling material, and Create machines are what you submit to the Codex to bank Tier 1 tokens.$(br2)$(bold)Key IridescentCraft interactions:$() Brass is a required material throughout T1. Mechanical Crafters automate the bulk crafting you feed into Codex submissions. The Deployer can automate enchanting table interactions.

$(bold)What's gated:$() Nothing in Create is tier-gated. The entire mod is available from Tier 1.$(br2)$(bold)What's recommended:$() Build a brass auto-crafter early. Brass costs are higher than vanilla Minecraft expects them to be — plan for it.$(br2)$(bold)Artificer synergy:$() Artificer's Efficient Engineering passive boosts machine speed. A T1 Artificer player can set up extremely efficient Create lines.

$(bold)No book needed.$() Create uses an in-world $(bold)Ponder$() system — hold $(bold)W$() while hovering any Create block in JEI to open an animated tutorial. It's one of the best in-game documentation systems in any mod.
